scenes.aiSummary: The dragonets awaken after the egg’s vision, recall formative childhood experiences, and plan a restaurant with music and swings.
Grandpa Jim berates Little Tony and reports awakening statues, roads, fountains, and food machines.

scenes.locationDetail: Food apparatus on the pilgrimage road nearest the Wanderer
scenes.aiSummary: The party experiments with the food machine; Ilse summons them to Oru while offering restaurant advice.

scenes.locationDetail: Oru's tent at the Great Temple
scenes.aiSummary: Oru investigates the party’s egg experience and reactivated machinery until Rosca arrives with news of the Wanderer’s open eye.
The Wanderer invites Little Tony closer; the four dragonets and Rosca pass through its opening iris while Oru remains outside.
The shaft lights and hums around the dragonets, renewing their extraordinary gifts.

scenes.locationDetail: Approach to the Wanderer's guardian chamber
scenes.aiSummary: Four huge guardian statues appear below; Little Tony hears defensive warnings and discovers telepathic communication with his companions.
The guardians attack Rosca; the party protects him and Sculpit teleports him outside, ending their aggression.

scenes.locationDetail: Guardian chamber and stairs to the Wanderer's heart
scenes.aiSummary: The guardians welcome the party, who ascend resonant stairs toward the heart chamber.
Four welcoming seats connect the dragonets to the statue; their thoughts about moving awaken its machinery and illuminate its body.

scenes.locationDetail: Narrated cutaway: hovering vessel beyond the surrounding storm
scenes.aiSummary: Two humanoids detect divine energy and four distinctive signatures, discussing the resistance and firstborn.

entities.label: Mysterious engraved egg
entities.aiSummary: The party awakens beside the dark egg and discusses its vision and gifts with Oru.

entities.label: Purple dragonet in the remembered vision
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls a severely wounded purple dragonet and asks Oru whether its appearance identifies it.

entities.label: Man with the jade hand
entities.aiSummary: The remembered vision associates a jade hand with comforting affection from the wounded dragonet’s best friend.

entities.label: Uncle Kaz
entities.aiSummary: Zeno remembers meeting Uncle Kaz during a childhood visit to a mountain monastery with extraordinary choral rituals.

entities.label: Dragonet monks of the mountain monastery
entities.aiSummary: Zeno recalls serious, apparently flightless monks whose singing resonated through the monastery and served a long project.

entities.label: King of the Hermit Crabs
entities.aiSummary: Little Tony recalls sparing a golden-shelled magical hermit crab whose misunderstood wish gave him the ability to talk to anything.

entities.label: Horseshoe Brad
entities.aiSummary: Little Tony names Horseshoe Brad as one of his usual morning contacts in the tide pools.

entities.label: Piglet (unclear morning contact)
entities.aiSummary: A fragmented reply appears to name Piglet as another of Little Tony’s usual contacts on the island.

entities.label: Grandpa Jim the Cloud
entities.aiSummary: Little Tony’s judgmental cloud acquaintance reports the island’s magical awakening and repeatedly criticizes Tony’s lack of purpose.

entities.label: Awakened food machine
entities.aiSummary: The ancient roadside apparatus responds to the party’s presence and music, producing nested fish and then a chaotic mixture of food and metal.

entities.label: Paul (Paulie)
entities.aiSummary: Little Tony's cousin describes the machine’s inconsistent food production and watches Zeno awaken it.

entities.label: Joey
entities.aiSummary: Paul says Joey wished for salted salmon and the food machine produced it during the night.

entities.label: Xena
entities.aiSummary: Xena is among the breakfast crowd, approaches her brother after his food-making success, and catches Heska’s attention with interest in his fish story.

entities.label: Ilse
entities.aiSummary: Oru’s assistant summons the party after their food experiments and enthusiastically offers restaurant advice until his supervisor intervenes.

entities.label: Ilse's supervisor
entities.aiSummary: An unnamed shamanic dragonet redirects Ilse from restaurant brainstorming to the summons and accompanies the party to the temple.

entities.label: Dragonet shamans
entities.aiSummary: The shamanic elders investigate the island’s strange awakening and seek the party’s explanation through Ilse and Oru.

entities.label: Shaman Oru
entities.aiSummary: The oldest known dragonet and head festival elder investigates the awakening machinery and listens to the party’s egg story. He accompanies them to the Wanderer’s eye but asks them to report back while he remains outside.

entities.label: Circular clockwork artifact
entities.aiSummary: Oru displays a small circular object whose interlocking wheels resume clicking near the party after briefly activating during the night.

entities.label: Rosca (Roska)
entities.aiSummary: Rosca brings news of the Wanderer’s eye and accompanies the party inside, where guardian beams severely injure him. Little Tony persuades him to retreat and Sculpit teleports him to safety.

entities.label: The Wanderer statue
entities.aiSummary: The enormous statue invites the party inside and responds to their presence, leading them to a welcoming chamber. Their attempts to move it awaken its machinery and light its eyes and body; no completed walk is shown.

entities.label: Four guardian statues
entities.aiSummary: Four enormous constructs inside the Wanderer attack Rosca but become welcoming after he leaves, bowing to the remaining party.

entities.label: Glenda the Seagull
entities.aiSummary: Little Tony’s familiar assists his attempt to communicate with the guardians, while he remains troubled by her romantic attachment.

entities.label: Eight seats in the Wanderer’s heart
entities.aiSummary: Eight seats surround the heart chamber; four specifically welcome the dragonets and seem perfectly fitted to them as energy stirs around all eight.

entities.label: Hovering vessel beyond the storm
entities.aiSummary: A closing narrated cutaway shows a vessel beyond the island’s storm containing two observers and an energy-detecting device.

entities.label: Two humanoid observers
entities.aiSummary: In the closing cutaway, two humanoids react emotionally to divine energy signatures and their significance for the resistance and firstborn.

entities.label: Energy-signature device
entities.aiSummary: The observers’ device displays shifting lights that they interpret as divine energy and four distinctive signatures.

entities.label: The resistance
entities.aiSummary: The unknown observers say the discovery of divine energy will change everything for the resistance.
